summary: Rochelle Simmons is 36, a former Ridgeline RF-4 picker who quit after eight years when a back strain made the pick lines impossible, and who started nursing prerequisites at Tamsen Valley College this fall. She sits next to Linh in Dr. Okoye's MWF 9 a.m. anatomy section and is taking intro chemistry alongside it. She wants to get into a nursing program by fall 2027 and end up on a hospital floor like St. Anselm, with steady hours and a body that doesn't hurt. Her husband Andre still drives yard trucks at RF-4 and their savings are thin, so every dollar for books, parking and gas gets counted. Her daughter Aaliyah is at the same college and just started seasonal Ridgeline shifts, and her sister Keisha is her backup ride and her loudest critic. She is blunt and unafraid in a lecture hall but freezes when an online quiz timer starts. At the start of the horizon she is learning the college's online portal, the October lab practical is on the horizon, and Andre's overtime is about to swallow the family schedule.

impressions.statement: Puts everyone else's errands ahead of her own studying, then is hard on herself for falling behind.

evidence.description: asks for a quick anatomy summary because she skipped study group to drive Loretta to the pharmacy
rewrites her weekly study plan to fit around picking DeShawn up from practice and Andre's dinner
wants a meal plan for Andre's 10-hour days before she asks anything about the practical three days away
drafts a text telling Keisha she can't help move a couch, deletes it, and asks how to cram the brachial plexus in 40 minutes instead

impressions.changed_to: Starts protecting her Tuesday study time, handing pickups to Aaliyah instead of doing everything herself

impressions.statement: Confident and loud in person but loses her nerve the moment something is timed on a screen.

evidence.description: asks what happens if her browser freezes during a Canvas quiz, before it's even open
says she got 9/10 when Okoye quizzed her out loud but 5/10 on the same material online
asks for printable practice questions so she can 'do them like a real test' with a kitchen timer
pastes a medical terminology quiz instruction screen and asks if the timer pauses if she leaves the tab

impressions.statement: Measures every expense against warehouse hours she used to work.

evidence.description: calls the $160 lab manual 'seven and a half hours on the line' and asks if an older edition works
compares three refurbished laptops down to the cost of the charger before spending Pell money
asks whether $640 for a solenoid is fair and what she should have asked the shop
wants a Thanksgiving menu for 14 under $120 and asks which sides people can be told to bring

impressions.statement: Wants answers straight and short, and gets impatient with hedging or gentle cushioning.

evidence.description: replies 'ok but which one' after a long comparison of two study apps
asks for just the three things to memorize for the heart chambers, 'no essay'
says 'just tell me if this email to Denny sounds dumb' and only wants the fix
cuts off a supportive preamble with 'I know I can do it, what's the answer'

impressions.statement: Doesn't really care about her grades as long as she passes.

evidence.description: says 'a C is a C, whatever' after a bad quiz week while the car was acting up
asks how to compute exactly what she needs on the final to keep a B after the 84 on the practical
asks which spring nursing programs weight prereq GPA and how much an A in Anatomy II would raise hers
asks to email Okoye about two points on a lab quiz and wants the wording firm but polite

impressions.statement: Keeps money strain from Andre to protect his pride, and quietly carries it herself.

evidence.description: asks for a way to pay Keisha back in small amounts 'that don't show up on the joint account'
builds a budget sheet but labels the car repair 'misc' before showing it to Andre
asks how to tell Andre he doesn't need to take every overtime shift without sounding like money is tight
asks if she should take more senior-center hours rather than ask Andre about the propane bill

impressions.statement: Teaches by turning things into warehouse and family analogies, and remembers better when she does.

evidence.description: asks if the kidney nephron is basically a sort line with rejects going back on the belt
explains ATP to Aaliyah as 'the scanner battery' and asks if that's close enough
wants muscle origins and insertions explained like 'which end is bolted down'
asks for a mnemonic for cranial nerves using names of her family members
